categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the semiconductor specialized equipment manufacturing sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of crystal growth equipment. Its main products include semiconductor-grade single crystal silicon furnaces, silicon carbide (SiC) single crystal furnaces, and other customized equipment. Additionally, it provides related technical services and auxiliary materials, serving semiconductor material manufacturers and other material customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as high-temperature and high-vacuum crystal growth equipment, multi-physical field coupling simulation, precise thermal field design, automated crystal growth control systems, and visual image-based control technologies. It employs proprietary algorithms for crystal growth control, PIDF nested multi-loop control, and modular equipment design to enhance stability and precision. Production methods include Physical Vapor Transport (PVT), Top-Seeded Solution Growth (TSSG), and Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) for SiC and GaN crystal growth.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading semiconductor material manufacturers and downstream semiconductor companies in China, including Shanghai Xinxing, Jinruihong, Shengong, Sanan Optoelectronics, Tony Electronics, Hejing Technology, and BYD. The end markets served include semiconductor wafer manufacturing for integrated circuits, power devices, automotive electronics, photovoltaic, industrial applications, 5G communications, and emerging fields like AR/VR devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are primarily concentrated in mainland China, with a focus on serving domestic semiconductor manufacturers. It also maintains awareness of international semiconductor technology trends and aims to expand overseas business and international cooperation, but the main revenue and production are China-based.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream to midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in the manufacturing of semiconductor-grade crystal growth equipment essential for producing silicon and silicon carbide wafers. It supplies equipment to semiconductor material manufacturers who then produce wafers for chip fabrication.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes becoming a domestic leader in semiconductor crystal material growth equipment by continuous innovation and R&D investment. It focuses on enhancing equipment precision, automation, and stability, integrating AI and big data technologies into control systems, and expanding product lines to include CVD, cutting, thinning, and polishing equipment. The company also prioritizes talent acquisition and international technology collaboration to drive high-quality technological innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the direct sales of customized semiconductor crystal growth equipment and related auxiliary products. The company also earns income from after-sales maintenance, technical services, and upgrades. Sales are conducted primarily via direct sales channels with professional sales and service teams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier of semiconductor-grade crystal growth equipment, especially in silicon carbide single crystal furnaces, with technology and product quality comparable to international advanced manufacturers. It holds a strong competitive advantage in customer certification barriers and customization capabilities. Competitors include other domestic and international semiconductor equipment manufacturers, but the company benefits from early market entry and established relationships with major Chinese semiconductor firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 425 million, representing a 4.78% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 53.7 million, a decrease of 24.32%. The company maintains a solid asset base with total assets around RMB 1.87 billion and equity of RMB 1.58 billion. R&D investment accounted for over 10% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented profile focused on innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies, high customization capabilities, and stable, high-precision crystal growth equipment that meets stringent semiconductor-grade standards including COP-FREE silicon wafers and high-quality SiC substrates. Its integrated solutions combining equipment, control systems, and process technology enable customers to improve crystal quality and yield, reduce costs, and accelerate product development cycles. The company also emphasizes responsive customer service and proximity to domestic clients as competitive advantages.
